game.name: Stardew Valley (RG34XXSP / KNULLI)
game.desc: Stardew Valley mainline PortMaster adaptation for Anbernic RG34XXSP running KNULLI. Includes built-in motor rumble, KNULLI battery HUD, preparation caching, CPU/rendering optimizations and optional SMAPI. Requires your own clean Windows or Linux Steam mainline game files. ARM64 community port; see the repository README for installation and current limits.
